title: Intelligent chemical production mode occupational health risk identification, assessment and intervention study
content:
by Yin Fei Shen, Jian Qing Xu

The intelligent transformation of the chemical industry has reshaped petrochemical production workflows and altered occupational-health risk landscapes. This paper delineates four typical operating scenarios for intelligent chemical manufacturing and develops a four-tier hierarchical risk indicator system covering objectives, criteria, factors, and measurable indicators. A hybrid entropy-weighted Bayesian-network evaluation model is established, where entropy weights calibrate prior probabilities of root-node inputs while conditional-probability tables are retained to characterize risk-coupling behaviors. Model performance is validated via time-series partitioning, multi-model benchmark comparisons, and cross-validation using Monte-Carlo simulations. An entropy-weighted TOPSIS multi-criteria decision-making method is adopted to rank intervention-target priorities, and discrete time-series analysis quantifies outcomes from a six-month closed-loop intervention program. Results demonstrate that human-machine interaction, psychological, and managerial risks dominate occupational-health hazards within intelligent chemical-production contexts. Three highly sensitive critical drivers are identified: operating-instruction error rate, risk-monitoring gap duration, and information-overload frequency. Multi-criteria decision analysis further reveals that high-sensitivity risk factors do not inherently represent optimal intervention targets. The proposed model achieves 88.2% prediction accuracy on time-series test datasets, and statistically significant overall-risk reduction is observed post-intervention. This work offers theoretical support for risk identification, equipment retrofitting, and worker-health protection for smart petrochemical sites, facilitating the synergistic advancement of chemical-industry intelligent modernization, operational safety, and employee occupational-health outcomes.
